summary: BifrOSt has no Apple Watch and no WCSession. The generic request and reply peer session covers two-way messages between two BifrOSt devices, which is the nearest counterpart.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.feature: Two-way messages between a phone app and its companion
features.note: request and reply messages between a client and a server side; not a companion-app pairing
no queued transfer that survives a disconnect

features.feature: Watch hardware and companion app pairing
features.apple: WCSession with a paired Apple Watch
features.note: requires an Apple Watch, which BifrOSt does not support

gaps: No companion-app pairing and no queued transfers.
